entry.title: Kraken Parent Payward Agrees to Buy Lithuania’s Saldo Bank
entry.summary: Saldo reported €196.9 million in assets at the end of June. The acquisition is expected to close in 2027, subject to regulatory approval.

entry.title: XLM Drops 4%, Lagging Bitcoin and Ether
entry.summary: Stellar announced native Chainlink data services for DeFi applications, while XLM’s seven-day loss reached 7.85%.

entry.title: Specter Links ProveX’s January ETH Inflows to Earlier Heart-Linked Funds
entry.summary: The receiving address was published by Heart for a campaign that warned participants their coins could be sold and they would receive no benefit.

entry.title: Rocket Pool Voters Back rETH Withdrawals, Keep 4 ETH Bonds
entry.summary: Voters chose random megapool exits and deferred an onchain governance expansion. The full Saturn 2 upgrade package still needs ratification.

entry.title: Bubblemaps Alleges Anglio-Linked Wallets Traded Ahead of Pump.fun Calls
entry.summary: The analytics firm estimates $50,000 in trading profits and $80,000 in callout rewards, as Pump.fun shifts payouts toward followers’ returns.

entry.title: UNCX Vesting Pool Exploited for About $86,000, Blockaid Says
entry.summary: The identified transaction took five different tokens, while the affected Ethereum contract still held about $3.25 million in assets.

entry.title: Uniswap Launches ETH/USDC Pool With Separate Buy and Sell Fees
entry.summary: The VolatilePair Hook adds temporary charges on trades reversing large price moves, aiming to retain more arbitrage value for liquidity providers.

entry.title: EBA Names USDC the EU’s First ‘Significant’ E-Money Token
entry.summary: Financial supervision shifts to the EBA on Nov. 12, while France’s ACPR keeps responsibility for governance and other corporate matters.

entry.title: Babylon Advances Native Bitcoin Collateral Plan for Aave V4
entry.summary: The proposal would keep collateral on Bitcoin but use WBTC to settle permissionless liquidations. Risk settings and further governance votes are still pending.

entry.title: Ekubo Adds Shadow Accounts for Liquidity Providers
entry.summary: The feature uses existing pools rather than a separate private market; LP positions and transaction details remain visible onchain.

entry.title: Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul on Interpol Notice, Turkish Media Report
entry.summary: Interpol’s public record identifies Finland as the requesting jurisdiction and lists aggravated tax fraud; Heart’s separate SEC case was dismissed in 2025.

entry.title: Bastion Demands $3.50 SkyAI Tender Price and Board Overhaul
entry.summary: The shareholder says it will not participate on current terms. SkyAI’s latest filing reports 600,000 SOL remaining and cash covering about 80% of the proposed offer.

entry.title: OCC Finds Debanking Policies at Nine Major US Banks
entry.summary: Digital-asset issuers and exchanges faced restrictions, while the regulator is considering further rules without announcing bank-specific penalties.

entry.title: EQX Plans 11 Tokenized Stock and ETF Markets on Hyperliquid
entry.summary: The share-backed tokens would trade on HyperCore against USDC, with US persons excluded under EQX’s eligibility rules.

entry.title: Evernorth Taps Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo for XRP Yield Push
entry.summary: The Nasdaq-listed treasury company plans to start institutional strategies in Q4, with direct XRP Ledger credit-market investments to follow as the infrastructure matures.

entry.title: US Inflation Accelerates to 3.7% as Gasoline Prices Jump
entry.summary: Core inflation climbed to 2.6% annually, while gasoline accounted for more than half of September's monthly headline increase.

entry.title: L2 Capital Signs On To Tokenize $500 Million Of Pre-IPO AI Shares With Newton
entry.summary: The Hong Kong firm is the first partner on a platform Newton Labs is still building. Compliance rules would sit inside each token and be checked before every transfer settles.

entry.title: Qivalis Secures Dutch E-Money License for Planned Euro Stablecoin
entry.summary: The 37-bank venture plans to distribute its token through financial intermediaries, with issuance expected in the coming months.

entry.title: PancakeSwap Proposes 88% LP Fee Share and 69% CAKE Emissions Cut
entry.summary: The discussion-stage plan would send the remaining v3 and Infinity fees to the treasury, while leaving v2’s CAKE burn mechanism intact.

entry.title: Standard Chartered Launches Bitcoin and Ether Trading for Affluent UAE Clients
entry.summary: The bank’s closed-loop service bars external crypto transfers and charges a spread of up to 2%.

entry.title: Ledger Asks Resellers to Halt Sales in Seven Asian Markets
entry.summary: The hardware-wallet maker says confirmed incidents remain confined to Southeast Asia, with no indication its systems or direct sales channel were compromised.

entry.title: Optimism’s OP Jumps 18%, Extending Four-Week Gain to 66%
entry.summary: OP outpaced bitcoin and ether over matched daily and multiweek windows, though Starknet’s STRK posted a much larger four-week rally.

entry.title: Collector Crypt Logs $151 Million in Monthly Pack Sales
entry.summary: Solana pack buyers doubled in the third quarter, but 548 wallets accounted for 83% of spending, according to Pine Analytics.

entry.title: BNY and Citadel Securities Use Tokenized Treasury in Overnight Repo
entry.summary: A two-year note settled within minutes on BNY’s private digital ledger before Citadel Securities used it to raise cash.

entry.title: FBI Reports $17 Billion Scam-Center Tally as West Africa Raids Net 28 Arrests
entry.summary: DOJ says a coordinated enforcement week removed more than 3.7 million online accounts, pages and groups and identified over $11 million in potentially freezable funds.

entry.title: DOJ Announces Two Arrests in North Korean ‘Laptop Farm’ Crackdown
entry.summary: Prosecutors allege a scheme affecting more than 70 US employers generated about $3 million. The Ohio indictment describes cryptocurrency transfers.

entry.title: Parlays Drive Kalshi’s $3.9 Billion Trading Days, Analysis Finds
entry.summary: Combos supplied roughly 70% of weekend notional volume, according to Bitcoin.com’s analysis, but that measure is not cash spent by buyers or a count of new users.

entry.title: JUP Rises 51% in Four Weeks as Jupiter Fees Decline
entry.summary: JUP outpaced bitcoin and ether despite a 5.6% weekly pullback. Fees across Jupiter’s products fell to $16.82 million in the latest complete 28-day period.

entry.title: APT Gains 51% in Four Weeks, Outpacing Bitcoin and Ether
entry.summary: The token's weekly return is nearly flat, while DefiLlama's tracked stablecoin market cap on Aptos has fallen 17.5% over four weeks.

entry.title: Robinhood Opens Social Trading Feed to Eligible US Customers
entry.summary: Users can share charts and portfolio allocations, while a rollout on the Legend desktop platform is planned in the coming weeks.

entry.title: MediaMarktSaturn Pulls Ledger Products Amid Tampering Reports
entry.summary: The retailer says the withdrawal covers all its countries. Ledger says no fund losses were reported in the German case and directs existing buyers to support.

entry.title: Blockchain.com Seeks CFTC Licenses for US Derivatives and Prediction Markets
entry.summary: The company is seeking both exchange and futures-broker registrations to serve retail and institutional customers. The proposed US offering still requires approval.

entry.title: Base Introduces Earn & Borrow With Aave and Morpho
entry.summary: Apps can embed variable-rate stablecoin lending and crypto-backed loans, while borrowers remain subject to the underlying protocols’ liquidation rules.

entry.title: cirBTC Borrowing on Morpho Tops $190 Million as Arc Liquidity Tightens
entry.summary: About 97.4% of supplied USDC is borrowed in the main market, compared with 8.1% when Circle Mint opened access on Sept. 21.

entry.title: Avalanche Highlights KSD Links Ahead of Korea’s 2027 Tokenization Rollout
entry.summary: KSD’s platform is being built to connect with Avalanche, Hyperledger Besu and Hyperledger Fabric, with Samsung SDS targeting completion in February 2027.

entry.title: UK Court Rules Chinese Law Governs Victims’ Claims to 61,000 Bitcoin
entry.summary: The roughly $5.1 billion holding remains contested after victims lost their bid to rely on English law to establish ownership.

entry.title: MNX Launches Futures on AI Lab IPOs and Revenue
entry.summary: The contracts offer leveraged exposure rather than shares, with settlement tied to IPO filings, private-market valuations or revenue estimates.

entry.title: Mezo Sets Oct. 13 Bridge-Out Deadline for swBTC and USDe
entry.summary: SolvBTC and xSolvBTC withdrawals will close Oct. 29. Deposits are already suspended for all four tokens.

entry.title: Zest Sets Oct. 23 Deadline to Exit aeUSDC on Stacks Market V1
entry.summary: The lending protocol says Allbridge will end its aeUSDC bridge to Stacks on Nov. 3. Its one-transaction migration to V2 excludes aeUSDC.

entry.title: Anza Sets Oct. 21 for Solana’s Alpenglow Mainnet Upgrade
entry.summary: The upgrade targets 150-millisecond finality, while validators and block-data providers face software changes before the switch.

entry.title: StarkWare Launches Shadow Accounts on Starknet
entry.summary: Apps can hold DeFi positions under separate, persistent identities, but balances, amounts and contract calls remain public.

entry.title: Interactive Brokers Launches Ethereum Staking Through Zerohash
entry.summary: Eligible clients keep at least 70% of staking rewards under the broker’s agreement, while withdrawals remain subject to network waiting periods.

entry.title: Trezor Shrinks Reseller Network After Hardware Wallet Supply-Chain Incidents
entry.summary: CryptoBilis is already off Trezor’s seller list. The company says the wider reduction is preventive and that it has no evidence its devices were compromised.

entry.title: DRW and Marex Execute Bond-Index Swap on Canton
entry.summary: The Derivnex trade links a shared contract record to licensed S&P benchmark data, with cash and collateral integration planned next.

entry.title: Mysten Reports Sui's First Native Quantum-Safe Devnet Transaction
entry.summary: The devnet implementation adds ML-DSA-65 account signatures. Native mainnet support is targeted for Q1 2027, subject to audits and testnet feedback.

entry.title: Metaplanet Plans ¥52 Billion Bond Sale to Refinance Bitcoin Loans
entry.summary: The company would replace some Bitcoin-collateralized borrowing with unsecured debt and devote up to ¥28.3 billion to share repurchases.

entry.title: Autheo’s THEO Plunges 92% After Suspected Bridge Exploit on Base
entry.summary: Autheo urged users not to buy, sell or bridge THEO after a 19 million-token mint and subsequent sales on Base.

entry.title: Karpelès Says Airport-Bought Ledger Flex Contained Spy Implant
entry.summary: Buyer Ben Yorke identified Metapod as the retailer. Ledger says verified fund losses in its investigation remain tied to CryptoBilis-sold wallets.

entry.title: 21Shares Lists Anthropic Synthetic ETP on Vienna MTF
entry.summary: CLAU holds FalconX notes tied to perpetual futures, with financing and funding costs on top of its 1% annual product fee.

entry.title: Sanctioned A7 Announces USDT-to-SWIFT Payment Service
entry.summary: A7 International advertises a 0.3% fee and payouts in four currencies, but its public materials do not name the banks that would execute the transfers.

entry.summary: Ledger says the added hardware leaves the secure chip and operating system untouched. Its Genuine Check cannot rule out this kind of tampering.

entry.title: Crypto Trader ‘Realist’ Reports Knifepoint Robbery at UK Home
entry.summary: The trader valued the robbery at about $800,000. Transaction records show the Solana address he identified received nearly 719,000 USDC, which later moved on.

entry.title: Robinhood Reports $15B in Stock Token Trading as Chain Passes 100 Days
entry.summary: The company says its stock tokens have reached 200,000 holders, while Morpho’s dashboard shows about $1.1 billion deposited on the network.

entry.title: IMF Finds Most Tokenized Equity Trading Happens Outside Regular Hours
entry.summary: The fund says demand for round-the-clock access is real, but building deep, liquid and resilient markets remains a challenge.

entry.title: Canton Records Over $155 Million in Q3 Fees, CertiK Says
entry.summary: The network burns Canton Coin to pay for services, while its recorded daily fee pace was below the 30-day snapshot Converge reported in June.

entry.title: Citi Details Stablecoin Checkout With Coinbase and Fiat Payouts
entry.summary: The US-first expansion would let institutional merchants receive fiat without holding digital assets. General availability and supported tokens remain unspecified.

entry.title: Ontology Restarts Mainnet After Nearly 43-Hour Security Halt
entry.summary: Ontology says no funds were lost from the network itself, but its restart statement leaves losses at the unnamed ecosystem project unresolved.

entry.title: Derive Proposes Treasury Funding for US-Regulated Derivatives Push
entry.summary: The Foundation would gain authority to pursue approvals and establish or acquire entities, but the proposal sets no spending amount or launch date.

entry.title: Sui Backs DATA With $30 Million as Network Plans to Retire Its Chain
entry.summary: DATA balances are slated to carry over one-for-one onto Sui, but support for validator staking and smart contracts on the chain formerly known as Story will wind down.

entry.title: Standard Chartered Launches RLUSD Custody Through Dubai Branch
entry.summary: A planned link with LMAX would let institutions use the stablecoin as collateral without transferring it to the trading venue.

entry.title: THORChain Fees Rebound but Remain 84% Below September Surge
entry.summary: The latest seven-day total is back above the pre-surge week, after fees plunged 91% in Oct. 2–8.

entry.title: Pando Sets Oct. 13 Hong Kong Listing for Spot Solana ETF
entry.summary: The fund will charge a 0.60% annual management fee, adding another option alongside ChinaAMC’s Solana ETF, which held $8.58 million at the end of August.

entry.title: SkyAI Sells Half Its SOL Treasury, Plans $201 Million Cash Buyback
entry.summary: The proposed $3-per-security offer targets 95% of eligible shares and warrants, with an expected condition that SOL’s closing price remains above $100 during the offer period.

entry.title: Buyer Reports Second Tampered Ledger From MediaMarkt, Calls for Recall
entry.summary: Ledger Support still says confirmed cases involve CryptoBilis. The buyer named distributor Aqipa and said the second device is being sent to Ledger for analysis.

entry.title: USDGO Adds Solana Trading Liquidity Through Jupiter Lend and Fluid
entry.summary: Anchorage Digital Bank issues the OSL-branded stablecoin, which has about $1.29 billion in circulation. USDGO lending markets are planned next.

entry.title: OneKey Cuts Off CryptoBilis, Offers Free Wallet Replacements
entry.summary: All OneKey models bought from the reseller between March 1 and Oct. 12 qualify, including used devices. Buyers must apply by Dec. 31.

entry.title: Karpelès Flags Another Ledger Implant as Company Keeps CryptoBilis Warning
entry.summary: Ledger's security documentation says Genuine Check cannot detect spying implants that leave the secure chip intact, a limit affecting buyers beyond any one reseller.

entry.title: Bitquery Says $10 Million Frozen in CryptoBilis-Linked Wallet Drains
entry.summary: The firm's $93.2 million loss estimate spans six chains, while Ledger's latest update offers no repayment plan for affected buyers.

entry.title: Bybit Launches USDC-Funded Trading in More Than 1,000 US Stocks and ETFs
entry.summary: Alpaca executes trades and holds the underlying shares, giving eligible users a brokerage alternative to Bybit’s tokenized xStocks products.

entry.title: Papertrade Trader Losses Reach $32.4 Million Two Days After Launch
entry.summary: The loss-funded venue booked more revenue than Pump.fun and Hyperliquid in the latest shared full-day data, while its house pool held about $4.27 million.

entry.title: Kraken Plans UAE Launch After Securing Full Dubai License
entry.summary: The planned rollout includes dirham deposits and withdrawals, AED trading pairs, staking and xStocks, with retail investors covered by Payward’s license.

entry.title: ESMA Calls for Noncompliant Stablecoin Wind-Down by Jan. 8
entry.summary: The regulator’s opinion includes custody and transfers, moving beyond earlier guidance that allowed those services to continue.

entry.title: CZ Alleges Hackers Bought CryptoBilis as Ledger Probes Wallet Drains
entry.summary: The reseller’s former founders say they handed over operations in March and that their acquisition agreement delayed a public announcement until mid-October.

entry.title: ENSv2 Activation Proposal Would Halt New ENSv1 Registrations
entry.summary: Existing .eth holders would have no migration deadline, while ENS Labs would hand its remaining ENSv2 admin roles to the DAO.

entry.title: STRK Gains 322% in Four Weeks, Outpacing Bitcoin and Ether
entry.summary: Starknet’s DeFi TVL rose about 5% over a slightly shorter period, while its proposed Layer 1 shift remains under discussion.

entry.title: AVAX Gains Nearly 50% in Four Weeks, Outpacing Bitcoin and Ether
entry.summary: The token retained its lead despite a 1.7% weekly decline, while Avalanche shortened the minimum commitment for validators during the period.

entry.title: Ledger User Reports Hardware Implant in Wallet Bought in Europe
entry.summary: Ledger says all confirmed cases tied to its October 9 fund-draining investigation involve Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis, which has halted hardware-wallet sales.

entry.title: Coinbase Completes Deribit Integration for Institutional Traders
entry.summary: Former International Exchange clients gain Deribit's options suite and margin system, while US Prime options trading follows a separate rollout.

entry.title: Ledger Says All Confirmed Draining Cases Involve CryptoBilis-Sold Devices
entry.summary: The company says its direct sales channels are unaffected and reminds resellers never to restock returned products.

entry.title: Liquid Bitcoin Redemptions Remain Frozen With 85.8% Reserve Coverage
entry.summary: The reserve gap is about 603 BTC. Liquid says peg-outs require full backing and completed security reviews before they can restart.

entry.title: Papertrade Says It Is Tightening Trading Limits After Manipulation Allegations
entry.summary: The team says it is restricting exposure onchain and through relayers. Its statement does not confirm claims that a trader was blacklisted or prevented from closing positions.

entry.title: PeckShield Traces $3.89 Million in Ledger Theft Funds to Binance Deposits
entry.summary: The reported Tron deposits offer investigators an exchange-account lead, but intermediary wallets handling other clients’ money complicate attribution.

entry.title: XRP Ledger Discloses Decade-Old Bug That Could Mint Trillions
entry.summary: The flaw was fixed in xrpld 3.4.1 on Sept. 25. Developers found no evidence it was exploited on a public network.

entry.title: US Bitcoin ETFs Shed $679 Million in Weekly Reversal
entry.summary: Withdrawals on Oct. 7–8 drove a $920 million swing from the preceding week, leaving the two-week flow total negative.

entry.title: COLDCARD Warns of Phishing Post on Its Official X Account
entry.summary: The company says it found no matching login record. A researcher found the fake migration site was built to collect wallet recovery phrases.

entry.title: Filecoin Nears End of Six-Year Vesting, Removing 68 Million FIL in Annual Releases
entry.summary: At the latest mining pace, annualized additions from vesting and block rewards would fall from about 89 million FIL to 21 million. Storage-provider rewards continue.

entry.title: Papertrade Faces Oracle-Manipulation Allegation as House Pool Shows $3.14 Million
entry.summary: The cited wallet showed about $1.73 million in realized trading gains on PaperDash. Papertrade’s loss-funded pool pays winners, with unpaid profits queued if cash runs short.

entry.title: SUI Gains 54% in Four Weeks, Outpacing Bitcoin and Ether
entry.summary: Sui’s DeFi liquidity also expanded, but more slowly than its token price, while a recent pullback interrupted the rally.

entry.title: Pump.fun to Tie Callout Rewards to Followers’ Profits
entry.summary: Low-cap token recommendations will earn less under changes starting with the Oct. 10 payout, co-founder Alon said.

entry.title: Papertrade Traders Lose $18.2 Million as Staking Rewards Reach $12.6 Million
entry.summary: Reported staking rewards equaled about 69% of net trading losses, but the payouts redistribute money to PAPER stakers rather than reimburse each losing trader.

entry.title: Ledger Says Affected User’s Device Contained Hardware Implant
entry.summary: CryptoBilis has stopped selling all hardware wallet inventory pending the investigation, according to Ledger, widening an earlier pause request limited to Ledger devices.

entry.title: Papertrade Shows $10.3 Million in Staker Rewards Hours After Launch
entry.summary: The 1000x-leverage venue’s dashboard showed roughly $5 million in its house pool and no queued payout debt as trading losses funded PAPER rewards.

entry.title: Papertrade Draws Reported $3 Billion in Positions in First Hour
entry.summary: DefiLlama tracked $137.1 million in trader balances and house liquidity combined. Those funds are not all available to pay winning trades.

entry.title: StarkWare Calls Starknet L1 Shift Its 'Clearest Path Forward'
entry.summary: Starknet still settles on Ethereum, and its official account described an L1 move as 'a question, not a decision' a day earlier.

entry.title: Wallet Linked to CryptoBilis Thefts Routes 464 ETH to Tornado Cash
entry.summary: Ethereum records show the money passed through an intermediary and four deposit wallets, while the source address retained about 700 ETH.

entry.title: Papertrade Sets 1000x Perps Launch With $85 Million Deposited
entry.summary: Trading is scheduled for 10 a.m. ET on Oct. 10. User deposits are separate from the house-side pool, which starts at zero and grows from traders’ losses.

entry.title: AERO Rallies 48% in Four Weeks, Outpacing Bitcoin and Ether
entry.summary: Aerodrome holds about $393 million on Base as its planned merger with Velodrome approaches.

entry.title: $3.55 Million in Unclaimed Bridge Funds Moved via EIP-7702
entry.summary: The transactions used valid account authorizations, but BlockSec says they do not establish whether the wallet owner knowingly approved the transfers.

entry.title: Ledger Theft Funds Shift Into USDD, Beyond Tether’s Freeze Controls
entry.summary: Tron records show a 2 million USDT conversion through USDD’s stability module; Bitquery estimates Tether froze $10 million across the wider theft cluster.

entry.title: STRK Jumps 30% as Starknet Weighs Layer 1 Shift
entry.summary: The token’s rally outpaced bitcoin and ether, while daily trading on Starknet’s decentralized exchanges rose to about $33.7 million.
